svg.title: Signed group-network difference, Experimental minus Control
svg.desc: Two-dimensional signed group comparison on GMR1 and SVD2. Each connection is drawn once in the stable color of the stronger selected group; width encodes the absolute Primary-minus-Secondary difference. Dashed guides show separate marginal 95% Student-t confidence intervals for each displayed arithmetic group mean, not a joint region or significance test.
